gloss: good results; excellent performance; strong record

definitions.gloss: good results; excellent performance; strong showing
definitions.explanation: Outstanding or better-than-expected results in academics, sports, business, or other measurable endeavors.

examples.japanese: {好成績|こうせいせき}を{収|おさ}めた。
{彼|かれ}は{大会|たいかい}で{好成績|こうせいせき}を{残|のこ}した。
examples.english: He posted a strong performance at the tournament.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}の{努力|どりょく}が{実|みの}り、{期末|きまつ}テストで{好成績|こうせいせき}を{取|と}ることができた。
examples.english: My daily efforts paid off, and I was able to get good grades on the final exams.

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}は{好成績|こうせいせき}を{維持|いじ}して{優勝|ゆうしょう}を{目指|めざ}す。
examples.english: This season, I aim to maintain good results and win the championship.

notes:
Composed of {好|こう} (good, favorable) and {成績|せいせき} (results, grades, performance). The prefix {好|こう} elevates the base word to indicate above-average or praiseworthy outcomes.

Used across academic, athletic, and business contexts. In academics, it refers to good grades or exam scores; in sports, to strong placements or records; in business, to favorable sales figures or performance metrics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {好成績|こうせいせき}を{収|おさ}める: to achieve good results
- {好成績|こうせいせき}を{残|のこ}す: to leave behind a strong record
- {好成績|こうせいせき}を{取|と}る: to get good grades
- {好成績|こうせいせき}を{維持|いじ}する: to maintain good results
- {好成績|こうせいせき}を{上|あ}げる: to produce good results

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {成績|せいせき}: results, grades — the neutral base word without the positive connotation
- {好結果|こうけっか}: good outcome — focuses on the end result rather than measurable performance
- {優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{成績|せいせき}: outstanding grades — uses an adjective rather than a compound noun
